source: Bitview / Bitcoin Research Kit public series API
permissionNote: Private local research candidate only. The API docs list an MIT license for the API project, but a separate license covering redistribution of these metric values was not confirmed.

series.mappingNote: Provisional semantic mapping from Bitview mobile supply to the catalog liquid-supply ID. The source uses age-range spending probabilities, not entity labels.
series.sourceDefinition: All-chain Coinflow aggregates weight every UTXO age range by its estimated future spending probability. Supply multiplied by the estimated remaining-lifetime probability of spending for its UTXO age range. Each age-range contribution is rounded down to whole satoshis before aggregation. Reported in BTC; one BTC equals 100,000,000 satoshis.

series.mappingNote: Provisional semantic mapping from Bitview immobile supply to the catalog illiquid-supply ID. The source uses age-range spending probabilities, not entity labels.
series.sourceDefinition: All-chain Coinflow aggregates weight every UTXO age range by its estimated future spending probability. Supply multiplied by one minus the estimated remaining-lifetime probability of spending for its UTXO age range. Each age-range contribution is rounded down to whole satoshis before aggregation. Reported in BTC; one BTC equals 100,000,000 satoshis.
